subject: Social Media
title: Internet Shutdowns
description: A micro-lesson that makes Internet Shutdowns usable.

hook.text: India turned off the internet in Kashmir for 552 days—the longest shutdown in any democracy. Silence by switch.

buildup.text: Governments cut internet access during protests, elections, and exams. In 2023, there were 283 shutdowns globally.

discovery.text: Shutdowns cost economies billions. A single day offline costs India $24 million. Governments pay the price willingly.

twist.text: Shutdowns don't just silence protesters. They kill businesses, block emergency services, and isolate entire regions.

climax.text: The internet was designed to survive a nuclear war. It can't survive a government with an off switch.

punchline.text: The kill switch is the ultimate moderation tool.

quiz.question: How long did India shut down the internet in Kashmir?
